boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations spanning downtown storefront blocks, civic corridors, and public recreation spaces within Harrisonburg’s practical campus orbit.

cards.title: See What Valley Artists Are Making
cards.subtitle: 100 block of South Main Street
cards.notes: Step into the nonprofit artist cooperative to view rotating original artwork, then continue along the South Main storefronts.
cards.short_summary: A downtown block anchored by a cooperative gallery representing Shenandoah Valley artists and artisans.
cards.evidence_claim: OASIS Fine Art & Craft is a nonprofit artist cooperative at 103 South Main Street that exhibits original work by approximately 35 area artists and artisans.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Thursday 11 a.m.–5 p.m., Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday noon–6 p.m.

cards.title: Start With Two Small History Museums
cards.subtitle: 200 block of South Main Street
cards.notes: Enter the historic visitor center for maps, travel help, and exhibits in the Valley Turnpike and Civil War orientation museums.
cards.short_summary: A South Main history stop combining visitor services with two compact museum experiences.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hardesty-Higgins House Visitor Center at 212 South Main Street contains the Valley Turnpike Museum and Civil War Orientation Center.
cards.source_title: Things To Do | City of Harrisonburg, VA
cards.access_notes: The city lists the visitor center and both museums as open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., with stated holiday closures.

cards.title: Find the Walk-Up Dairy Bar
cards.subtitle: 00 block of East Wolfe Street
cards.notes: Use the East Wolfe block for a clearly marked walk-up ice-cream stop; check the posted weekly flavor before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A compact East Wolfe destination centered on Kline’s downtown dairy-bar window.
cards.evidence_claim: Kline’s operates its Downtown Harrisonburg dairy bar at 58 East Wolfe Street and publishes a changing flavor of the week.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are Sunday 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m., Monday–Thursday 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m., and Friday–Saturday 10:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Stock Up at the Community Grocery
cards.subtitle: 100 block of East Wolfe Street
cards.notes: Bring a reusable bag and browse the downtown cooperative’s local and organic groceries; ownership is not required to shop.
cards.short_summary: An East Wolfe grocery block with an independently operated, community-owned food cooperative.
cards.evidence_claim: Friendly City Food Co-op is a community-owned downtown grocery at 150 East Wolfe Street, and its official site states that anyone can shop there.
cards.access_notes: The co-op’s official site lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; purchases are open to non-owners.

cards.title: Browse an Independent Bookshop
cards.subtitle: 00 block of West Gay Street
cards.notes: Turn onto West Gay Street to browse the general-interest shelves and check the shop’s calendar for readings or story times.
cards.short_summary: A West Gay storefront block offering new books and scheduled literary events.
cards.evidence_claim: Parentheses Books is an independent general-interest bookstore located at 76 West Gay Street in Harrisonburg.
cards.access_notes: Consult the shop’s current event announcements before planning around a reading or story time.

cards.title: Make the Mason Street Bike Stop
cards.subtitle: 00 block of South Mason Street
cards.notes: Roll or walk to the South Mason storefront for bicycle service, route information, or equipment before exploring farther afield.
cards.short_summary: A South Mason block anchored by a locally operated bicycle shop and service counter.
cards.evidence_claim: Rocktown Bicycles operates at 50 South Mason Street, Suite 100, and offers bicycle service and route information.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are Monday–Friday 11 a.m.–7 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; the shop is closed Sunday.

cards.title: Time the Block for Market Morning
cards.subtitle: 200 block of South Liberty Street
cards.notes: Arrive during a scheduled market session to meet producers and browse seasonal food, plants, prepared items, and local crafts.
cards.short_summary: A South Liberty market block activated year-round by regional growers and makers.
cards.evidence_claim: Harrisonburg Farmers Market operates at 228 South Liberty Street, with Tuesday and Saturday markets from April through November and Saturday winter markets.
cards.access_notes: April–November sessions are Tuesday and Saturday 8 a.m.–1 p.m.; December–March sessions are Saturday 9 a.m.–1 p.m.

cards.title: Choose a Recreation Loop
cards.subtitle: 300 block of South Dogwood Drive
cards.notes: Head down South Dogwood and choose one activity: follow the disc-golf course, use the skate park, or pause at a picnic shelter.
cards.short_summary: A South Dogwood recreation corridor gathering multiple outdoor facilities in one municipal park.
cards.evidence_claim: Westover Park at 305 South Dogwood Drive is a 48-acre city park with a skate park, disc-golf course, playground, picnic shelters, pool complex, and activity center.
cards.source_title: Westover Park | City of Harrisonburg, VA
cards.access_notes: Individual facilities have separate schedules and conditions; consult the linked city pages before using the pool or skate park.

cards.title: Walk the Park’s Short Trail
cards.subtitle: 400 block of East Washington Street
cards.notes: Use the East Washington entrance for a short walking loop, or bring a ball for the basketball and futsal courts shown on the park map.
cards.short_summary: An East Washington park block with a mapped walking route and several active-recreation spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The city map places Ralph Sampson Park at 431 East Washington Street and identifies walking routes, basketball courts, a futsal complex, playground, shelters, and spraygrounds.
cards.source_title: Ralph Sampson Park Map | City of Harrisonburg
cards.access_notes: The city map notes that restrooms operate seasonally from mid-April to late October and dogs must remain leashed.

cards.entity_name: Lucy F. Simms Continuing Education Center
cards.title: Read the Permanent Simms Exhibit
cards.subtitle: 600 block of Simms Avenue
cards.notes: Enter from Simms Avenue and ask to see the permanent exhibit documenting the school and Northeast neighborhood’s contributions.
cards.short_summary: A Simms Avenue civic destination preserving local Black educational and neighborhood history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lucy F. Simms Continuing Education Center at 620 Simms Avenue permanently houses an exhibit about the Lucy F. Simms School and Harrisonburg’s Northeast neighborhood.
cards.source_title: Lucy F. Simms Continuing Education Center | City of Harrisonburg, VA
cards.access_notes: The city lists hours of 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Friday and 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday; call regarding holiday or event closures.
